front.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: orthographic prop concept sheet for the original fictional game VEILBOUND HUNTERS.
Edit target Image 1 is the current village-forged long sword front view. Image 2 is the approved short sword, a MATERIAL AND CRAFTSMANSHIP reference only. Image 3 is the approved overall ART STYLE board only.
Create one corrected FRONT view of the long sword, preserving the simple original design: long slim single-edged worn grey steel blade, a tiny plain riveted bronze crossguard, a long plain brown diagonally wrapped leather two-hand grip and a bronze pommel. The cutting edge is LEFT and the thick spine is RIGHT. No cultural decorative patterns. No new decorative features.
Output canvas MUST be 1536 pixels wide by 2048 pixels high (3:4 portrait), pale solid warm grey background edge to edge, completely opaque. Keep generous empty space at both sides. Only ONE sword, vertical, exact orthographic flat front view; no perspective, no visible side face of the blade, no tilt, no cast shadow, no floor, no person, no hand, no text, no frame, no labels or dimension lines.
The existing sword is too short-bladed and almost straight. Correct its proportions using this precise invisible layout:
- total projected weapon length is 1800 px, from topmost point at y=124 to pommel bottom at y=1924.
- grip axis x=768; grip including pommel extends from y=1520 to y=1924, corresponding to 33 cm.
- crossguard and mount occupy y=1495 to y=1520, corresponding to 2 cm. Guard width 98 px (8 cm), not oversized.
- blade starts at y=1495 and ends at the tip y=124, corresponding to 112 cm, of the 147 cm total length.
- blade width is about 39 pixels (3.2 cm) across most of the length. Blade must look VERY SLIM relative to the two-hand grip.
- curve the blade gradually and smoothly toward its RIGHT spine. Tip x=817: the upper tip is displaced approximately 49 pixels to the RIGHT of the grip axis, corresponding to 4 cm. The blade must have a clearly readable but extremely gentle single smooth curve; no kink, no S bend. Slanted clipped tip, a simple diagonal point related to the approved short sword.
Please maintain these proportions and output dimensions, with all parts intact and fully visible. Render polished detailed original production concept art in the muted grey-green, aged bronze and brown leather style of the references. Do NOT draw the invisible measurement layout.
